test.create(worker)
test.create(worker::/count_up::count)
test.set_value(worker::/count_up::count, 4)
test.create(worker::/count_up::sum)
test.create(worker::/count_up::trigger)
count_up.execute(operation<standard:/number/integer/increment>, count)
count_up.execute(operation<standard:/number/integer/add>, count, 10, sum)
count_up.destroy(trigger)
test.destroy(worker::/count_up::count)
test.destroy(worker::/count_up::sum)
test.destroy(worker)
